thread:
Sam: Sentinel Med POC kickoff — they want a stepped-ramp perf run Wed 10am PST. Goal: sustained 200 QPS, short 3s spikes to 1200 QPS, p95 <250ms, p99 <600ms. Need load plan + cost ballpark. @Nina @Oliver please
Nina: Quick Q — can you confirm workload mix? chat completions vs embeddings vs rerank?
Sam: Mix: 70% chat (short prompts ~40 tokens), 20% embeddings (512-d), 10% rerank. KV/prefix warmup expected.
Oliver: Ops note: recommend Dedicated pool with KV cache warmup. Autoscale cooldown 60s. Any KMS constraints?
Maria: Security: they require data residency in us-west-2, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), and an SSO/SAML flow. Also a short questionnaire response is needed.
Kevin: For perf I suggest a two-phase ramp: 0->200 QPS over 10m, hold 20m, then staircase spikes 200->1200 QPS with 3 bursts. Test both redwood-base-quant (fast) and redwood-xxl (quality) for fallback. Enable prefix caching and short KV TTLs.
Nina: I'll draft the runbook. Quick k6 snippet for generator path: 
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt:'summary'}), {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
}
```
Oliver: Add health probes + a bursting policy: route to a cheaper variant or region if p95 > 400ms. Capture token-per-request and model-switch events in traces.
Sam: Customer asked pricing delta hosted vs dedicated for this profile — ballpark needed before call.
Kevin: Ballpark: hosted ~ $0.004/token for short-chat profile (includes infra/support). Dedicated, with a 6mo commit, can get to ~ $0.0025/token. For burst billing add ~30% on top for on-demand capacity. I'll put a couple of scenarios in the spreadsheet.
Maria: I'll prepare the KMS flow diagram and a short security Q&A doc (no creds, just architecture and controls).
loadbot: test-run created: sentinel-med/stepped-ramp-2026-03-24-10:00 (ops ticket #7891) :rocket:
Nina: Action items: I’ll share runbook + cost spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow. Sam — you have the customer intro at Wed 9:30 PST.
Sam: Perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
